$comment: The base bundle — the source language. §E10.1: every string in the product resolves through src/lib/i18n/strings.ts, and the Phase 5 locale registry overrides these by key. A locale added in the control plane appears in the UI with no code change because these keys already exist. Nothing here is a colour, a number, or a format; those are tokens.

clay.title: Places on this map
clay.listHint: The same places the model shows, as a list. Every tier renders both.
clay.canvasLabel: Clay model of {city}. The list below carries the same places.
clay.empty: No place on this map has a published location yet, so there is nothing to draw.
clay.weather.note: The model's light is this city's local time and the model's rain is its real weather — the same monsoon context that seasonally normalises contractor deadlines.
degraded.pressReduced: Printing in two inks at a coarser screen, so the model keeps its frame rate. Bolder, not lesser.
degraded.lensReduced: Depth of field and gate weave are off on this machine.

degraded.storyboard: Showing the printed storyboard instead of the model. Same places, same figures, no animation.
degraded.contextLostTwice: This machine's graphics device dropped the model twice, so we have stopped rebuilding it and switched to the printed version. Nothing is missing from the figures.
story.skip: Skip the film and go straight to the receipts
story.name: NEMESIS
story.scroll: Scroll. The walk goes as far as you take it.
story.walk.described: A figure walks the length of a road in a clay city. Nothing happens, at length.
story.stop.described: The camera drops to ankle height. The pothole fills the lower third, water standing in it, the tar broken at the lip. The figure's shoulders drop.
story.silence.quote: That silence isn't apathy. It's the sound of a system that broke its promise once too often.
story.silence.described: Ghost flags fade in along the same stretch of road, one for each report that was never closed. They dim together.
story.report.note: This is the citizen app itself, running here. Not a picture of it.
story.report.described: The figure raises a phone and the camera pushes through the screen into the viewfinder.
story.pipeline.note: Every gate stamps the card with what it found. A stamp is an event from the log, never a status flag.
story.pipeline.waiting: Nothing is in the pipeline right now. Send a report in the act above and these stamps come from its own ledger, live.
story.merge.heading: Three reports, one incident
story.merge.live: This isn't an animation. It's a live event from the pipeline.
story.merge.waiting: No merge has come through the stream yet. This scene waits for a real cluster match rather than playing one.
story.merge.rings: Deduplication is not deletion. The reports that were absorbed leave their registration rings.
story.city.heading: The city, awake
story.table.note: The model, photographed on the bench it was made on. The next frame is the console.
story.receipts.heading: The receipts
story.receipts.note: Deliberately boring. Everything below is a real read from this deployment.
story.receipts.honesty: What is real, what is simulated, and what is still a roadmap item
story.storyboard.heading: The Walk, in nine frames
story.storyboard.note: Printed rather than played — same nine acts, same words, no motion.
sound.reducedMotion: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the city's ambient sound and the map's positional sound stay off. The stamp and the safety note still play.
field.title: Field
field.online: Connected. Anything waiting will send itself.

field.noQueue: This phone cannot save work offline — its storage is blocked or unavailable. Reports will only send while you have signal.
field.jobs.title: Your jobs

field.capture.title: Photograph the job
field.capture.noPlace: Waiting for a location fix. A photo without one cannot be placed, so the button stays off until this phone knows where it is.
field.capture.exifKept: Kept — the city can verify when and where this was taken
field.capture.exifGone: Not in this photo. It will still be accepted, and it will be trusted less.
field.outbox.title: Waiting to send
field.outbox.state.parked: Stopped — this needs someone to look at it
